calls.thesis: Overlooked pharma-software name that 'runs pharmaceutical companies' end to end — sales through R&D — with 'a lot of legs' left; chart is at a turning point like the other three.
calls.base_case: Rebounded nicely but still in the 'opportunity zone'; big pharma keeps buying more of its services.
calls.bull_case: The cornerstone of medical R&D commercialization; AI in drug research multiplies demand for the secure data platform pharma already depends on.
